description: Capability bundles (recipes) compose AgentHub packages and tracked third-party extensions for a job. Bundles are install-planning metadata; they are not mega-plugins and do not vendor upstream code.

bundles.title: Technical series production
bundles.summary: Produce a fictionalized technical story series with evidence-bound capture, explanation, and optional Remotion composition.
notes: story-series-studio and technical-storytelling land in a later commit on this plan.
Product Demo Studio stays separate; do not route series work through it by default.

bundles.title: Engaging learning
bundles.summary: Attention-friendly exam coaching with optional visual explainers.
notes: learning-studio lands in a later commit on this plan.
Remotion/animations are optional enhancements, not required to answer a question.
